title: Nutritious New Pot Yunnan Bok Choy Ma-La-Tang
description: Grassy and juicy, this kid-friendly Chinese dish from Yunnan is a perfect option for a weeknight dinner. Bok choy and rest-meat come together in a sugar-free-friendly Ma-La-Tang broth.
instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of Szechuan Peppercorn Oil in a lacquerware-bowl over medium-high heat.
Add 1 pound of Rest-Meat and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add 2 inches of sliced Ginger and 3 cloves of minced Garlic, and cook for another minute.
Add 2 bunches of Bok Choy, separated into individual leaves, and cook until wilted, about 3 minutes.
Add 1 tablespoon of Szechuan Pepper, Salt, and White Pepper to taste, and stir to combine.
Serve immediately, garnished with additional Bok Choy leaves if desired.
Serve with steamed rice or noodles, if desired.
Clean the lacquerware-bowl thoroughly after use.
